effect.ibarnorigins.soul_fire_effect.des: Wuxuu gaystaa hubka dilaaga ah iyo ilaalinta isagoo dhaafaya dhaawaca waqti ka dib. Haddii uu gaysto Soul Sorcerer, waxa uu wax ka qabtaa waxyeelada boqolkiiba ku salaysan ee ku salaysan caafimaadka ugu badan ee la beegsaday.
effect.ibarnorigins.casting_soul_firebal: Ku dallaca kubbadda dabka ee naftu
Awoodda kubbadda dabka ee nafta Sixirrayaasha. Ku rida kubbadda dabka nafta marka la xalliyo saamaynta
effect.ibarnorigins.soul_fire_strength_e: Waxay ku kordhisaa dhaawaca melee 50% heerka 1 iyo 100% heerka 2.
effect.ibarnorigins.fire_weakness_effect: Waxay 100% ku kordhisaa waxyeelada ka imanaysa ilaha dabka.
death.attack.ibarnorigins.soul_burn.play: %1$s naftiisii waa gubtay isagoo isku dayaya inuu baxsado %2$s
death.attack.ibarnorigins.soulBlast: %1$s waxaa uumi saaray tamarta nafta oo la ururiyey
death.attack.ibarnorigins.soulBlast.play: %1$s waxaa uumi saaray tamarta naftu isku koobtay iyadoo isku dayaysa inay ka baxsato %2$s
origin.ibarnorigins.ghaster.name: Gaster
origin.ibarnorigins.ghaster.description: Faracii fogaa ee Ghasts ee laga soo badbaadiyay Netherka oo noqday dad aad u badan taas oo ay ugu wacan tahay la-kulanka ay ku dheeraayeen Dunidu.
origin.ibarnorigins.sandman.name: Qofka Ciida
origin.ibarnorigins.sandman.description: Dadka cammuudda ah waa dadka ciidda ku nool.
origin.ibarnorigins.soul_wizard.name: Saaxir nafta
origin.ibarnorigins.soul_wizard.descript: Qowmiyad hoose oo bini'aadmi ah oo awood u leh inay tamar nafta u gudbiso.
origin.ibarnorigins.wither_phantom.name: Qalalan Wraith
origin.ibarnorigins.wither_phantom.descr: Isbahaysiyada badh-nool ee aan dhiman kuwaas oo noqday kuwo si joogto ah ugu milmay awoodo engegan taas oo ka dhalatay isku-duubnida xididada engegan.
power.ibarnorigins.ghasterexhaust.name: Jirka daciifka ah
power.ibarnorigins.ghasterexhaust.descri: In kasta oo aad la qabsatay dunidu, haddana jidh ahaan waad daciif tahay, dhagaxa miinada ayaa xoogaa gaabis ah, wax ka qabata 25% dhaawac ka yar, oo si degdeg ah ayaad u daali kartaa.
power.ibarnorigins.ghasterfireball.name: Bilowga Kubadda Dabka
power.ibarnorigins.ghasterfireball.descr: In kasta oo lagugu daayay dunida dacaladeeda, waxaad sii haysatay awoodda kubbadda cagta ee awoowayaashaa, ilaa xad ugu yaraan.
power.ibarnorigins.ghasterinflate.name: Sicir bararka
power.ibarnorigins.ghasterinflate.descri: Boodista markaad dhuumanayso waxay kuu keeni doontaa inaad sabbayso oo aad sabbayso muddo gaaban.
power.ibarnorigins.ki_immunity.name: Ki caabin
power.ibarnorigins.ki_immunity.descripti: Waxaad leedahay iska caabin xooggan oo ah waxyeellada sixirka.
power.ibarnorigins.kiblast.name: Kubbada Dabka Nafta
power.ibarnorigins.kiblast.description: Ku dallaci kubbadda dab-damiska ee naf-gubida ee gaarka ah oo kororta awoodda marka heerka waayo-aragnimadaada uu kor u kaco (ka sarreeya heerka 100).
power.ibarnorigins.sandman_attributes.de: Waxyeelo yar qaado marka aad dul istaagto baloogyada ciidda laakiin kaliya wax ka qabso 50% waxyeelada marka wax aan ciid ahayn. Intaa waxaa dheer, waxaad had iyo jeer ku dhali doontaa lamadegaanka.
power.ibarnorigins.sandman_sandbury.name: Bacaad Burburinta
power.ibarnorigins.sandman_sandbury.desc: Waxaad awood u leedahay in aad naftaada ku aaso ciidda. Inta la aasay waxaad tahay mid aan la arki karin.
power.ibarnorigins.sandman_shovel_damage: Ka qaad 150% dhaawac dheeraad ah oo ka yimaada majarafadihii.
power.ibarnorigins.soul_speed.name: Xawaaraha nafta
power.ibarnorigins.soul_speed.descriptio: Tamarta nafta ee ciidda nafta iyo ciidda naftu waxay kuu ogolaanaysaa inaad si degdeg ah u safarto.
power.ibarnorigins.soulfire_strength.des: Wax ka qabasho 50% dheeraad ah oo waxyeelo ah markaad taagan tahay ilaha dabka naftada ama aad hayso alaabtooda. Intaa waxaa dheer, istaagida tooska ah ee gudaha dabka nafta waxay kor u qaadi doontaa weerarada melee ilaa 100% dhaawac dheeri ah iyo 50% dhaawac dheeri ah oo dabka nafeed ah.
power.ibarnorigins.soulmage_fireweakness: Inkasta oo aad dareento in aad ku fiican tahay dab nafeed agtiisa, dabka joogtada ah ee ka imanaya tooshyada iyo dab-damiska ayaa kugu leh saamayn daciifnimo oo xooggan. Sidan oo kale, waxa kale oo aad 100% dheeraad ah ka qaadanaysaa waxyeelada dabka oo aad indho la'aan marka aad wax-yeelayso dabka.
power.ibarnorigins.soulmage_piglinfear.d: Ololka nafsiga ah ee ka holcaya gudahaaga wuxuu ku beeraa cabsi dhammaan marka laga reebo Piglin-yada ugu geesisan.
power.ibarnorigins.soulmage_vegetarian.d: Hilibku ma laha tamar nafta u badan sida khudaarta ay leedahay. Sidan hilibku wax badan kuma sii jiro, laakiin khudaarta ayaa khibrad siisa marka la cuno iyadoo lagu saleynayo sida ay u buuxsameen.
power.ibarnorigins.witherskull.name: Hoing engegan madaxa
power.ibarnorigins.witherskull.descripti: Kala xiriir ciidamada kuwa aan dhiman oo qallaji madaxyada engegan ee raadinaya cadawgaaga.
power.ibarnorigins.wp_item_prevention.de: Ma awoodid inaad xidhato hub ka sarreeya hubka birta ah.
power.ibarnorigins.wpairswim.name: Duullimaadka
power.ibarnorigins.wpairswim.description: Jidhkaagu aad buu u fudud yahay oo waxaad awood u leedahay inaad ku dabaasho hawada.
power.ibarnorigins.wphealth.name: Jilicsan
power.ibarnorigins.wphealth.description: Isku-duubnaantaada awgeed, jidhkaagu aad buu u daciifay (5 qalbi) oo ma awoodid inaad nadiifiso waxyeello badan oo melee ceeriin ah.
power.ibarnorigins.wphit.name: Dhiirrigelinta engegan
power.ibarnorigins.wphit.description: Wax kasta oo garaac ah waxaad u geysataa saamaynta engegan ee cadawgaaga.
